model.title: Medication Affordability and Patent Integrity Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Maggie Hassan (D-NH)

summary.text: The bill would require companies seeking FDA approval for a drug or biological product to disclose information about related patents to both the FDA and the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office. Applicants would have to certify that the patent information they give the USPTO is complete and matches what they gave the FDA, and that certain FDA submissions are consistent with what they told the USPTO. The bill would also create a legal defense against a patent infringement lawsuit for a patent owner who negligently or intentionally failed to make these required disclosures.
